text: Performs this digital modulation operation, it will generate electromagnetic signals carrying these information bits. But then Wi-Fi needs to operate in a different portion of the spectrum. So these electromagnetic waves in the case of Wi-Fi needs to be brought to 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz or 6 GHz. Okay. So each wireless technology is allowed to operate on certain portion of the frequency spectrum. You cannot operate wherever you like. You need to as a technology need to operate on the frequency portion of the spectrum that has been assigned to that technology. To do that, so to bring the signals, electromagnetic waves, at the right in the right portion of the spectrum, we perform this second operation that is called analog modulation. The region of the spectrum for the frequencies where those electromagnetic signals need to be are also let's refer to as carrier. Okay, that's the central frequency where those signals need to be brought. At that point, they are ready to be transmitted. So there will be an antenna and a transmitter that will.
